svg.title: Membuat halaman HTML Mode di Scalev untuk undangan
svg.desc: 1. Di dasbor Scalev, klik Landing Pages di menu kiri. 2. Klik + Create Landing Page. 3. Pilih HTML Mode. Editor terbuka: Code, Media, Security, Settings. 4. Klik NikahKit di ujung strip. Menu selain Template dan Media terkunci. 5. Di tab Settings, isi slug, misalnya rani-dimas. 6. Klik Simpan di kanan atas editor. 7. Alamat berubah jadi app.scalev.com/pages/angka: itu ID undangan.

g.text: Looking for landing pages with an order form? They're now called Checkout Flows.
Only you are editing this page
Only you are editing this page
Only you are editing this page
Di dasbor Scalev, klik Landing Pages di menu kiri.
Pilih HTML Mode. Editor terbuka: Code, Media, Security, Settings.
Klik NikahKit di ujung strip. Menu selain Template dan Media terkunci.
Di tab Settings, isi slug, misalnya rani-dimas.
Klik Simpan di kanan atas editor.
Alamat berubah jadi app.scalev.com/pages/angka: itu ID undangan.
